When you create the account it i  highly recommended that you use a functional ID that is owned by your company rather than an employee's personal ID. user: What can you tell me about BM Cloud for Financial Services?
assistant:  I do not provide information about IBM Cloud for Financial Services.
[The End of Previous Conversation]

[The Start of Current Turn Question]
I am sorry. I want to know if IBM Cloud provides a service for  financial instituions.
[The End of Current Turn Question]

[The Start of Reference Answer]
Yes, IBM Cloud provides a service called IBM Cloud for Financial Services. This service is designed to help financial institutions meet the strict security and regulatory requirements of the financial industry. It includes a variety of features and tools to help financial institutions build, deploy, and manage secure and compliant cloud applications. The IBM Cloud Framework for Financial Services outlines the controls that services must comply with to be designated as IBM Cloud for Financial Services Validated. This validation indicates that the service has demonstrated compliance with the framework's controls and can be used to build solutions that may themselves be validated.
[The End of Reference Answer]

[The Start of Assistant's Answer]
提供的资料表明，IBM Cloud 有面向金融服务的 IBM Cloud Framework for Financial Services，并建议仅使用经过该框架验证的服务。[S3] 但是，现有证据不足以确定 IBM Cloud 是否提供专门面向金融机构的独立服务或具体产品。
[The End of Assistant's Answer]

[The Start of Document]
 IBM Cloud focuses on protection across the entirety of the compute lifecycle, which includes everything from the build process and key management to the security of data services. IBM Cloud also provides a group of security services that can be used by application developers to secure their mobile and web apps. These elements combine to make IBM Cloud a platform with clear choices for secure application development.

In addition to our own diligence in creating and operating a secure cloud, IBM® also engages many different firms to assess the security and compliance of our cloud platform. For more information, see [IBM Cloud compliance programs](https://www.ibm.com/cloud/compliance) for a detailed list of certifications and attestations.

See the best practice [Use only services that are IBM Cloud for Financial Services Validated](https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/framework-financial-services?topic=framework-financial-services-best-practicesbest-practices-financial-services-validated-services) for more details and potential exceptions.

 What if I don't want to use managed services, but I want to install and manage my own software?

Self-installed (or "bring your own") software from third parties is permitted without special approval. Examples include databases, logging stacks, web application firewalls, and so on. But just like first-party software you might develop and deploy, self-installed third-party software must comply with all of the requirements of the IBM Cloud Framework for Financial Services. And, it is your responsibility to provide appropriate supporting evidence.
